title: Question 6.2b: Confusion Matrix - Collecting Results
instruction: This code extracts specific columns from the predictions and brings them into memory as a regular Java list.
reveal: This code selects only the "label" (actual answer) and "prediction" (model's guess) columns from the predictions dataset, then collects all the rows into a regular Java List. The `.select()` chooses which columns to keep, and `.collectAsList()` brings the data from the distributed dataset into local memory so we can loop through it with a regular for loop.
